title: Coty to restructure France operations amid turnaround efforts
summary: The Kylie Cosmetics and Rimmel London owner has ‘proposed to adapt its operating model’ in France as part of its plans to halt declining sales under its ‘Coty:Curated’ strategy

extraction.key_fact: Coty가 매출 감소를 멈추기 위해 프랑스 사업 운영 방식을 바꾸려 한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The Kylie Cosmetics and Rimmel London owner has ‘proposed to adapt its operating model’ in France as part of its plans to halt declining sales under its ‘Coty:Curated’ strategy
